decision: Keep the original native-selection winner frozen. Use the subsequently registered empirical-game comparison to nominate at most one replacement for a further independent confirmation. Each of the five opponent identities receives equal weight, deduplicating identities if the incumbent is a control. For each arm, compute merit as 60% mean plus 40% worst opponent. Nominate the higher-merit new response only if its merit beats the incumbent and W-tap, its mean exceeds the incumbent by at least 0.05, and it earns at least half the available points against the incumbent. Otherwise retain the incumbent. Ties prefer the incumbent.
independent_retest: If a response qualifies, freeze the decision and both weights before collecting eight new mirror donors or native scores for this panel. W-tap, Hold-W, incumbent and nominee play each of five opponents: W-tap, Hold-W, anti-Hold, the previously withheld two-beat program and the round-four neural policy from the original ladder. Four repetitions for each 0/80 ms and seat, 16 actual bouts per opponent and 32 model bouts per opponent. All other competitive settings identical to the original 10-block MMC selection. A replacement must exceed the incumbent and W-tap on both native merit and native mean, score above W-tap on the same model field and achieve more than half the points against native W-tap. The same immutable names and weights remain available for human testing.
